author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as two dotted-eye faces over a bar table: tiny r2 heads, a shared horizontal arm bar joining both figures, and a shield stub fused to that bar. Now two r5-head stick figures, each with an exact 8-unit head gap: the officer holds a separate tall riot shield, and the protester leans in, pushing with a straight arm that stops 8 short of the officer.
omissions: Officer visor line, the protester's second arm, and hand-to-body contact (spacing forbids touching).
